title: Weekly Wine Report — Oct 15, 2026
html:
What's Popular Now

  • Vérité La Joie, Le Désir & La Muse 2023 — Featured in Decanter's "11 top fine wine releases from the US this fall" (Oct 7); Decanter says Vérité "regularly" earns 95+ but listed no scores for these vintages. Price not stated. Splurge pick. source
  • Quintessa Illumination Sauvignon Blanc 2025 & Inglenook Blancaneaux 2024/2025 (Napa) — Also on Decanter's fall US releases list (Oct 7). Scores and prices not stated. source
  • Goldschmidt Merlot Alexander Valley Chelsea Goldschmidt Guidestone Rise 2024 — Wine Spectator 92 pts, $25. WS Daily Wine Pick, Oct 13. Value pick. source
  • Result of a Crush Syrah Walla Walla Valley The Unnamed Series 2022 — Wine Spectator 93 pts, $32. WS Daily Wine Pick, Oct 15. Value pick. source
  • Tarlant Brut Nature Champagne Zero NV — Wine Spectator 94 pts, $79. WS Daily Wine Pick, Oct 12. source
  • Trend: California's wine correction is getting worse — Wine Spectator (Oct 8) reports Chapter 11 filings at Signorello Estate (Napa), Gundlach Bundschu and Robledo Family (Sonoma); Judd's Hill (Napa) has stopped making wine; Carlisle is closing. An analyst expects bargain wines to come out of the oversupply. source

Pinot Noir

  • Appassionata Fortissimo 2015 (Willamette Valley) — Decanter's fall US releases list (Oct 7). Score and price not stated. source
  • Björnson Vineyard Pinot Noir 2023 (Willamette Valley) — Decanter Editors' Picks (Oct 12), about $29. No score stated. source
  • South Willamette Valley Pinot Noirs: Benton-Lane Cima Single Block Series 2024, Broadley Vineyards Jessica 2024, Fullerton Three Otters 2024, Antiquum Farm Little Bud 2024 — Recommended in Decanter's "Southern stars" feature by Pete Holland (Oct 14). Scores and prices not stated. source

Napa Cabernet Sauvignon

  • Pym-Rae Tesseron Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 (Mt Veeder) — Decanter's fall US releases list (Oct 7). Score and price not stated. source
  • News: Signorello Estate in Chapter 11 — Signorello's debt is reported at $10M–$50M, and its winery and assets face an auction in Napa on Oct 16 if talks with creditors fail. Judd's Hill has also stopped winery operations (Wine Spectator, Oct 8). source
  • News: Honig adds ingredient labels — Honig Vineyard and Winery (Napa) is putting ingredient lists on its labels, starting with the 2025 Sauvignon Blanc Napa Valley due this fall. Not a Cabernet; WS calls Honig one of the first in Napa Valley to do this (Wine Spectator, Oct 2). source

Paso Robles

  • L'Aventure Côte à Côte, Estate Reserve & Optimus 2023 — Decanter's fall US releases list (Oct 7). Scores and prices not stated. source
  • News: Adelaida Cellars still restructuring — Adelaida filed Chapter 11 in 2024, and Wine Spectator's Oct 8 roundup of California's correction says its owners are still restructuring. source

Coverage gaps: CellarTracker: no community trending or most-tasted data reachable without logging in. Wine Enthusiast: no ratings or articles verifiably dated in the last 14 days. Vinous: no articles in the window, and scores are paywalled. Wine Spectator: Oct 31 Advance issue page failed to load; Insider Oct 7 could not be fetched; most article scores are paywalled. WS's big California Cabernet report (Sep 22) and California Pinot Noir report (Jul 29) are older than 14 days and were left out.
